Meta Adds Privacy Safeguards to AI Glasses

Meta has implemented new privacy safeguards for its AI-powered glasses following concerns raised about data collection. The company has introduced 'guardrails' to address these issues. Specific details on the nature of these guardrails or the exact privacy concerns were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
